segments.ch09.s0300: The Queen took Alice to see the Mock Turtle.
segments.ch09.s0310: They soon came upon a Gryphon, lying fast asleep in the sun.
segments.ch09.s0320: Up, lazy thing! Take this young lady to see the Mock Turtle, and to hear his history.
segments.ch09.s0330: And she walked off, leaving Alice alone with the Gryphon.
segments.ch09.s0340: The Gryphon sat up and rubbed its eyes, and watched the Queen till she was out of sight.
segments.ch09.s0360: What fun! It is all her fancy, that. They never executes nobody, you know. Come on!
segments.ch09.s0370: Everybody says come on here. I never was so ordered about in all my life.
segments.ch09.s0380: They had not gone far before they saw the Mock Turtle in the distance.
segments.ch09.s0390: He sat sad and lonely on a little ledge of rock.
segments.ch09.s0400: As they came nearer, Alice could hear him sighing as if his heart would break.
segments.ch09.s0420: It is all his fancy, that. He has not got no sorrow, you know. Come on!
segments.ch09.s0430: The Mock Turtle looked at them with large eyes full of tears, but said nothing.
segments.ch09.s0440: This here young lady, she wants for to know your history, she do.
segments.ch09.s0450: I will tell it her. Sit down, both of you, and do not speak till I have finished.
segments.ch09.s0460: So they sat down, and nobody spoke for some minutes.
segments.ch09.s0470: I do not see how he can ever finish, if he does not begin.
segments.ch09.s0480: Once, I was a real Turtle.
segments.ch09.s0490: These words were followed by a very long silence, and a great deal of sobbing.
segments.ch09.s0510: When we were little, we went to school in the sea.
segments.ch09.s0520: The master was an old Turtle. We used to call him Tortoise.
segments.ch09.s0530: Why did you call him Tortoise, if he was not one?
segments.ch09.s0540: We called him Tortoise because he taught us. Really, you are very dull!
segments.ch09.s0550: You ought to be ashamed of yourself for asking such a simple question.
segments.ch09.s0560: They both sat silent and looked at poor Alice, who felt ready to sink into the earth.
segments.ch09.s0570: Drive on, old fellow! Do not be all day about it!
segments.ch09.s0580: We had the best of educations. In fact, we went to school every day.
segments.ch09.s0590: I have been to a day-school too. You need not be so proud as all that.
segments.ch09.s0610: Yes, we learned French and music.
segments.ch09.s0640: Ah! Then yours was not a really good school.
segments.ch09.s0650: At ours they had at the end of the bill: French, music, and washing, extra.
segments.ch09.s0670: Reeling and Writhing, of course, to begin with.
segments.ch09.s0680: And then the different branches of Arithmetic.
segments.ch09.s0700: I never heard of Uglification. What is it?
segments.ch09.s0710: The Gryphon lifted up both its paws in surprise.
segments.ch09.s0720: What! Never heard of uglifying! You know what to beautify is, I suppose?
segments.ch09.s0730: Yes. It means to make anything prettier.
segments.ch09.s0740: Well, then, if you do not know what to uglify is, you are a simpleton.
segments.ch09.s0750: What else had you to learn?
segments.ch09.s0760: The Mock Turtle counted off the subjects on his flappers.
segments.ch09.s0770: Mystery, ancient and modern, with Seaography.
segments.ch09.s0780: Then Drawling. The Drawling-master was an old conger-eel, that came once a week.
segments.ch09.s0790: He taught us Drawling, Stretching, and Fainting in Coils.
segments.ch09.s0800: I went to the Classics master. He was an old crab, he was.
segments.ch09.s0810: I never went to him. He taught Laughing and Grief, they used to say.
segments.ch09.s0820: Both creatures hid their faces in their paws.
segments.ch09.s0830: And how many hours a day did you do lessons?
segments.ch09.s0840: Ten hours the first day, nine the next, and so on.
segments.ch09.s0860: That is the reason they are called lessons. Because they lessen from day to day.
segments.ch09.s0870: Then the eleventh day must have been a holiday?
segments.ch09.s0890: And how did you manage on the twelfth?
segments.ch09.s0900: That is enough about lessons. Tell her something about the games now.
